title: Tree
rootHint: The tree is built from the selected person. "Make root" remembers it as the project's starting person.
setAsRootHint: Make the chosen person the tree root and remember them as the project's starting person.
emptyProject: This project has no people yet — create the first one on the People tab.
emptyRelationships: No parents yet. Add them from the Family section of a person card.
truncated: Not all ancestor generations are shown — use the up arrow on the root card.
truncatedDescendants: Not all descendants are shown — use the down arrow on the root card.
collapse: The same ancestor appears more than once in the tree.
collapseDescendants: The same descendant appears more than once in the tree.
showBothHint: Ancestors above, descendants below. The arrows on the root card expand each direction separately.
showAncestorsHint: Direct ancestors of the selected person. The arrows on the left of the root card add and hide generations.
showDescendantsHint: Direct descendants of the selected person. The arrows on the right of the root card add and hide generations.
showBloodRelativesHint: Everyone connected to the root by blood: parents, children, siblings, aunts and uncles, cousins and further.
expandAncestors: Show one more generation of ancestors
collapseAncestors: Hide the farthest generation of ancestors
expandDescendants: Show one more generation of descendants
collapseDescendants: Hide the farthest generation of descendants
showWholeTreeHint: Show every person in the project without a root; kinship is not labelled in this mode.
wholeTreeWarning: The whole project tree is hard to read when fully expanded. Use it for an overview only.
